title: POST /api/fleet/enroll 201 response body, host enrollment
description: csm writes host_id and token to <csm root>/fleet/credentials.json (mode 0600) and opens the WebSocket at ws_url (default: the enroll URL's origin + /api/fleet/host, wss) with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Errors: 400 invalid body, 401 invalid code/key, 403 revoked/expired/locked, 409 key limit reached, 429 rate limited; body {success:false, code, error}.
